speaker: Flo
text: Like other Chinese senior citizens, Zhang and Wang were committed to their families and work, and traveling was not a priority option when they were younger. After retiring, Zhang decided to capitalize on this new-found opportunity to travel. The couple used their life savings to fund their expedition around the world.
